description: Definition of credential boundary: Code / Configuration / Secret / Runtime

code_layer.description: Source code that defines provider interfaces, adapters, and gateway logic
code_layer.verification: No hardcoded API keys found in source

configuration_layer.verification: Tables store only provider identity, base_url, model names, auth_type - no secret values

secret_layer.description: Secrets stored in runtime/secrets/secrets.json (encrypted via DPAPI on Windows)
secret_layer.access_pattern: secrets_store.get_key(provider_name) - returns secret value at runtime only
secret_layer.verification: No secrets in database, no secrets in git, no secrets in source

runtime_layer.description: Runtime credential injection through environment or secrets store
mechanisms: Environment variables: NVIDIA_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, OLLAMA_HOST
ProviderConfig.api_key field populated at runtime from secrets store
runtime_layer.verification: Credential only exists in memory during provider initialization

credential_flow.llm_provider_initialization: Requires api_key parameter or environment variable
